projects.title: Universal Login - Single Sign-On Across Two Healthcare Platforms
projects.description:
Unified authentication across two client-facing healthcare platforms - hospice pharmacy and durable medical equipment - so shared clinical users sign in once instead of maintaining two logins.

Led the web and middle-tier engineering. Built identifier-first login end to end: the user enters an email or legacy username, the system resolves their organization's identity provider and routes them into Okta SSO, Auth0, or the legacy credential flow. Delivered the full vertical slice across six layers - Angular SPA, ASP.NET Core BFF, .NET client SDK, API gateway, a new gRPC integration layer, SQL Server.

Selected work:
- Pre-authentication provider lookup at the gateway, Redis-cached - resolution must happen before the user holds any token.
- Integration layer bridging the established .NET platform to a greenfield gRPC identity service over HTTP transcoding, avoiding a monolith rewrite.
- Auth0/Okta OIDC with per-application audiences, federated sign-out, idle-timeout parity, and route guards - shipped feature-flagged beside the existing screen for per-environment rollback.
- Coordinated breaking contract changes across three independently deployed services, and authored the seven-repository promotion plan.

projects.title: Internal RAG Code Intelligence Platform & Claude Code MCP Server
projects.description:
Designed and built an internal RAG platform that makes a 10-repository healthcare pharmacy codebase searchable in natural language, then wired it into Claude Code as a native tool server.

The stack spans SQL Server, two generations of .NET backend, an API gateway, a client SDK, two mobile apps on different frameworks, an Angular portal, and Kubernetes manifests - so "where is this rule enforced?" meant grepping layers no one developer knows end to end.

What I built:
- Python/LangChain service over ChromaDB - ~28,000 code chunks across 33 collections, Azure OpenAI embeddings + chat.
- Hybrid retrieval: vector search for concepts, SQLite FTS5/BM25 with camelCase-aware tokenization for exact symbol lookups.
- Multi-collection retriever with per-collection score normalization and result quotas, so a 9,000-chunk repo can't crowd out a 100-chunk one.
- Incremental re-indexing driven by per-repo git commit tracking, with a resumable runner, stall detection, and retry.
- Compliance-aware indexing: chunks touching DEA/HIPAA-regulated workflows are tagged, surfacing regulatory context before the code is touched.
- An MCP stdio server exposing 7 tools - semantic and symbol search, regulated-context lookup, blast-radius analysis, index freshness, cache diagnostics - registered globally so every Claude Code session calls them like built-in file tools.
